title: Insurance Line Dictionary
subtitle: Maintain the line / sub-line / coverage dictionary and line applicability; consumed live by the product form and integration matching

fields.codeTipLine: Starts with an uppercase letter; letters and & only; 2-32 chars; immutable after creation
fields.codeTipSubLine: Same form as the product form values (e.g. Personal Auto, D&O); immutable after creation

empty.subLines: Add the first sub-line for this line
empty.noLineSelected: Select a line on the left

confirm.deleteLine: Delete line "{code}"? Deletion is soft and cannot be restored from the UI.
confirm.deleteSubLine: Delete sub-line "{code}"? Deletion is soft and cannot be restored from the UI.
confirm.deleteCoverage: Delete coverage "{code}"? Deletion is soft and cannot be restored from the UI.
confirm.disableWithRefs: {count} linked products still reference this item. After disabling, it cannot be selected for new products; existing products are unaffected.
confirm.disableNoRefs: Disable "{code}"? After disabling, it cannot be selected for new products; existing products are unaffected.

matrix.usageWarning: {count} products are using it; it cannot be selected for new products after unchecking; existing products are unaffected
matrix.coverageDisabled: This item is disabled; the link is kept

errors.DICT_IN_USE: Item is still referenced and cannot be deleted
